description: Record architecture decision: chose Electron over Tauri because WebKit on macOS causes production-breaking bugs (SVG shadows, audio glitching, WebKitGTK lacking WebRTC on Linux). Electron bundles Chromium giving consistent rendering. Acceptance: ADR doc created in docs/adr/ explaining tradeoffs.

description: Record architecture decision: chose Node.js+TypeScript for apps/server over Rust because team is TypeScript-first, Rust doubles toolchain complexity (Cargo+npm), and mission-control's backend needs (process spawning, WebSocket, SQLite) are well-served by Node. Acceptance: ADR doc in docs/adr/.
title: ADR: Node.js/TypeScript backend over Rust

description: Record architecture decision: build on mission-control's existing shell rather than forking t3code (Effect lock-in) or vibe-kanban (Rust backend). title: ADR: Build on mission-control shell vs forking t3code or vibe-kanban

description: Record architecture decision: mission-control is a local-first tool (spawns agent processes, accesses filesystem, manages PTYs) so a desktop app shell is appropriate over a purely hosted web app. Acceptance: ADR doc in docs/adr/.
